mechanism_narrative: The observed sustained decline in retail and recreation mobility over the past four weeks indicates a deepening trend of reduced non-essential activity, which will continue to drive RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If the mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than the mean over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: A continued decline in workplace mobility, specifically if it drops below -80% from baseline, signifies a further reduction in economic activity and daily commuting, which will suppress retail and recreation mobility over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES falls below -80% and RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than the mean over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of persistently high residential mobility (people staying home) and extremely low workplace mobility indicates a strong adherence to stay-at-home orders, which will continue to depress retail and recreation activity over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL remains above 30% and WORKPLACES below -70%, but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than the mean over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of tightening restrictions, the sustained extremely low transit station mobility reflects limited public movement, which directly translates to reduced access and inclination for retail and recreation activities over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: If TRANSIT remains below -85% and RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is higher than the mean over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: If parks mobility, already very low, experiences a further sharp decline (e.g., by more than 5 percentage points week-on-week), it suggests heightened public caution or stricter outdoor policies, which will negatively impact all non-essential outdoor retail and recreation over the next week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls by more than 5 percentage points week-on-week
failure_condition: If PARKS drops by more than 5 percentage points week-on-week, but RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is higher than the mean over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in grocery and pharmacy visits alongside sustained high residential mobility indicates an extreme level of public confinement and reduced essential outings, which will further depress retail and recreation mobility over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM falls below -60% while RESIDENTIAL remains above 34%
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM falls below -60% and RESIDENTIAL remains above 34%, but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than the mean over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: The consistent increase in residential mobility over the past four weeks signifies a growing trend of people staying at home, directly reducing their engagement with retail and recreation establishments over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If the mean RESIDENTIAL over the next 28 days is higher than the mean over the last 28 days, but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is also higher than the mean over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: In a deep lockdown regime, the sustained extremely low levels of both workplace and transit station mobility indicate that essential movement is severely curtailed, leaving no room for recovery in retail and recreation over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: If both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remain below -75% and -85% respectively, but RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is higher than the mean over the last 28 days.
